crossRefs.note: He shall skin the burnt offering, and cut it into pieces.
He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung
Yahweh God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin…
One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.
But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

translations.web: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
translations.bsb: As for the priest who presents a burnt offering for anyone, the hide of that offering belongs to him.
translations.kjv: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
translations.asv: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt-offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt-offering which he hath offered.
